confidence_notes: Medium. Meal, beer and coffee anchors rely on Numbeo Mérida figures seen in search results (inexpensive meal ~200-249 MXN, mid-range dinner for two ~900-1,000 MXN, draught beer ~55 MXN, cappuccino ~68-71 MXN). I loosely cross-checked these with Expatistan and local snippets. Numbeo pages disagreed with each other, so I used bounded mid-values. MXN was converted at an assumed ~17.3 MXN/USD that I did not verify. Cocktail (~135 MXN) rests on a few bar-guide ranges (~90-180 MXN). Wine by the glass (~145 MXN) rests on only two restaurant menus (~145-185 MXN). I sanity-checked both as roughly 2.4-2.5x the local beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for a hot, humid July, not from inspecting any listings, and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchored on Mérida-specific aggregates (Numbeo, Expatistan) plus local bar and restaurant menu price snippets. Accommodation judged by analogy with other colonial-heritage, tourism-oriented Mexican cities such as Oaxaca and Puebla. Mérida's Centro Histórico boutique-hotel boom and expat/digital-nomad demand nudge mid-range rates somewhat higher.
